trace_sampling_monitor.name: One Hand / Three Records
trace_sampling_monitor.description: Films three 3D records of the same Draw Dot pen gesture. Compare distance-based sampling separately from grid snapping. Reads the held pen without changing its trace or saved data; gaze controls the filmed replay.
interactions: Draw with a nearby Draw Dot pen.
Look at the monitor to watch or replay your gesture.
Switch to 10, 40 and 80 mm grid snapping.
trace_sampling_monitor.qfep_connection: The same gesture leaves different records according to what the system keeps and where it permits a point to stand. More retained points do not make an unsampled motion recoverable.

line_trace_monitor.name: Line and Trace / Live Illustration
line_trace_monitor.description: A camera films a private Godot scene. Two fixed endpoints retain the same straight segment while a moving point leaves three different sampled routes. Pause, replay or advance one sample.
interactions: Step to the next retained position.
Compare another route with the same endpoints.
line_trace_monitor.qfep_connection: A shared start and end do not determine the journey. The trace retains ordered samples; the segment disregards the intervening movement.
line_trace_monitor.validation: Prototype; see doc/book/iterations/2026-10-04-line-trace-monitor. Headset acceptance remains open.

triangle_reveal_monitor.name: A Drawing / Revealed
triangle_reveal_monitor.description: A private camera films copies of the Triangle drawing tool's actual corners and emitted faces. Watch a boundary become a fan, separate its faces and return them. Open drawings remain open. The source is never edited by the monitor.
interactions: Look at the screen to play; look away to pause.
Draw or edit with the existing triangle tool.
Pause, replay, step or turn the filmed view.
triangle_reveal_monitor.qfep_connection: The same boundary admits different internal connections. The source chooses its first stored corner as a fan anchor; a surface is the result of that decision.

polyhedra_reveal_monitor.name: Four Faces / An Enclosure
polyhedra_reveal_monitor.description: Films the existing tetrahedron's four positions, six edges and four faces, then unfolds its surface into a rigid net and folds it closed. Copies actual mesh data without changing the original body. Plays while viewed.
interactions: Look at the monitor to play.
Pause, replay or step through construction.
Turn the filmed camera to inspect the net and enclosure.
polyhedra_reveal_monitor.qfep_connection: The same triangular elements enclose a volume through their connections and relative angles. Visible enclosure and a physics boundary remain separate constructions.

resolution_reveal_monitor.name: Around / Along: Three Resolutions
resolution_reveal_monitor.description: A live camera films native cylinder, capsule and sphere meshes. Compare segments and rings independently, inspect actual triangle edges and explore every integer combination within S4-64 and R0-32 (sphere R1-32).
interactions: Look at the monitor to play; look away to freeze.
Pause, replay or step through the film.
Use S-/S+ and R-/R+ for each integer setting.
resolution_reveal_monitor.qfep_connection: Sampling around and along a body are independent choices. More geometry changes some silhouettes and leaves others intact; smooth shading is a separate decision.
